caption: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth glows beneath a generous mound of shredded cabbage and chopped green onions. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it rests on a warm wooden table under soft, ambient lighting.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
The spicy broth is vibrant red, glossy, and contains visible noodles and scattered green onions and garlic.
White ceramic bowl with blue geometric pattern and cartoon characters along its rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
